Record four accepted exits and one deferred, unmet obligation. Do not report 5/5 acceptance. Permit only the necessary sequencing exception for separately authorised later Core development. Preserve normal per-slice checks, comparison paths and all retirement conditions.

I accept the bounded sequencing exposure. I remain accountable for delivery through a named Phase 10 integration owner and for acceptance after independent review. Numerical budgets or improvement on another workload cannot discharge this obligation. If it remains unmet, beta acceptance is blocked.

decisions.authority:
Integrate pr 166, then switch to a small bit of housekeeping.

Chatgpt pro reviewed the git estate and the failing worktree and branch removal see attached md file for reccomendations. Review file then implement. I agree all level 3 changes in advance to improve efficiency of this repair.

Adopted owner addendum:

As project owner, I authorise the bounded Level 3 governance change needed to make eligible post-merge worktree and local branch retirement a Level 2 decision delegated to Codex.

Once accepted and integrated, Codex may decide and perform permanent deletion of eligible completed local worktrees and obsolete local branches, without my approval for each target. Preserve existing identity, containment, inactivity, inventory, preservation, audit and independent-review requirements. Retain active, unique, ambiguous or insufficiently preserved material.

Reconcile the canonical classification and Continue exclusions, connect retirement to the post-merge workflow, and update dependent checks. Remote branch deletion and force removal are excluded.

Publish one independently reviewed draft PR with the required diff and preservation evidence. Do not merge or exercise the new retirement authority during this task.
decisions.exclusions:
Preserve exact identity, accepted-history containment, the complete local-state inventory, independent preservation, snapshot and restore evidence, retirement audit, independent review and checks after removal. Make sure that no person or process uses the worktree. If necessary evidence is missing or has a FAIL result, keep the worktree and branch. Keep primary main, active state, unique content, ambiguous or uniquely owned state, and state without sufficient evidence of planned preservation.

Continue examines only the previous PR's recorded local worktree and branch after clean main synchronisation and repeated IDE workspace alignment. Examine their identities again directly before removal. Record retired, retained with reason, absent/already retired or assessment unavailable. Do not examine other worktrees or branches for removal.

Use only git worktree remove and the specified contained git branch -d after worktree removal. If a usual Git removal command gives a Git error, keep the worktree or branch that Git did not remove. Do not delete branches in another repository. Do not use force removal. Do not delete tags. Do not change the sequence of existing commits. Do not use git worktree prune, git stash or manual deletion of a directory and its contents. D-GOV-022 is not available through this authority. Preserve all frozen decisions and their limits.

This Level 3 alignment publishes one independently reviewed exact-green draft PR only. Do not merge the new draft. Do not use the new removal authority during this task.

Phase 9A stays closed at 4/4 for its frozen reference-only scope. Phase 9B stays Open at 1/6, with five exits Pending. Preserve the 113-entry register, geometry and all 24 risk duties. One no-replace directory operation makes the complete set available. CSV remains optional and is part of that same set when requested. Previous output files and directories remain unchanged.
